description: Service split for the fivetran provider. Ordered path rules, first match wins; every operation path must match a rule (bin/split.mjs and build_inventory.mjs fail without writing otherwise). The vendor's tags are close to this split but not identical: certificate and fingerprint operations live under /v1/connections and /v1/destinations but form their own service (the vendor tags them Certificate Management too); the three account-level admin surfaces (account info, roles, system keys) share the account service; private links and proxy agents share networking; hybrid deployment agents and the HVR hub registration share hybrid_deployment. Paths are matched as served by the vendor (camelCase path parameters, /v1 prefix).
